about_the_game: The soundtrack for Forklift : Stacked and Loaded includes all 3 remixes of the unused Credits theme, all 21 of the the in-game soundtracks (including the regular and Hurry Up themes), the Intro theme, sung by Sank Frinatra, along with an alternate take, the unused Sad Failure theme, all 3 versions of the trailer music and all 4 of the level select themes! 35 tracks to keep you company whilst you reminisce about that time you went for your Forklift Certification.
